description: This file defines the CustomerFacade interface, which serves as a bridge between the CustomerService layer and the web controllers in the shop management system. It declares methods for retrieving, updating, and managing customer data, including cart merging, customer registration, address handling, and authentication.

classes.name: CustomerFacade
classes.description: Interface connecting customer-related services with web controllers, providing methods for customer data retrieval, merging carts, registration, and address management.

methods.name: getCustomerDataByUserName
methods.description: Fetches customer data based on username and store, returning a CustomerEntity.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves a customer's readable data by their ID.

methods.name: mergeCart
methods.description: Merges the session shopping cart with the customer's cart during authentication.

methods.name: getCustomerByUserName
methods.description: Returns a Customer object for a given username and store.

methods.name: checkIfUserExists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists in the store.

methods.name: registerCustomer
methods.description: Registers a new customer and returns the CustomerEntity.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves address details for a user, based on billing or shipping.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates the address details for a user.

methods.name: setCustomerModelDefaultProperties
methods.description: Sets default properties for a Customer model based on the store.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication for a customer with username and password.

methods.name: getCustomerModel
methods.description: Creates a Customer model from a PersistableCustomer, store, and language.

methods.name: populateCustomerModel
methods.description: Populates a Customer model with data from PersistableCustomer.
